takes.h: BigBadWorkShop’s The Raven Society raises a glow-in-the-dark H.P. Lovecraft
takes.p: Bleeding Cool reports BigBadWorkShop, the team behind Operation: Monster Force, has opened pre-orders for the campaign-exclusive R.I.P. H.P. Lovecraft Founder Edition, a 1:12 figure in green translucent glow-in-the-dark plastic with a Cthulhu head and limbs, a typewriter and a tentacled book. Release is listed for Q2 2027.
